variant_name: growth by edit (plain host, then one edit turn)
prompt: Silhouette: Four-legged brown bear frame. Host frame: the brown bear sets the outline, body size and overall frame. A single brown bear. Head of the brown bear, fully visible and uncluttered, with clear, discernible eyes. Details: brown bear body and legs, with its own fur everywhere, plain coat. Bilaterally symmetrical, recognizable limbs, visible sense organs. Habitat cue (forest): dark back and light belly (mild countershading). Prosaic detail: natural lighting, feet in firm contact with the ground with a soft shadow, normal wear on hooves, claws and skin. One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.
edit_instruction: Grow, from the skin of the back and flanks, a covering of hard, glossy chitin plates with fine seams in its own colors that replaces the brown bear's fur over the back and flanks: it grows in the skin as the brown bear's own covering there, not as pieces added on top; the fur stops at the covering's edge, and the belly and legs keep the brown bear's own fur; the covering is a carapace grown in the skin like an armadillo's, shaped like a beetle's two elytra: one domed dorsal shield from the shoulders to the hips, in two halves meeting at a midline seam, never scattered plates. Also grow a single curved horn of hard, glossy chitin rooted on the nasal bone like a rhinoceros horn, its base merging into the skin of the brow. Keep the pose, the head, the legs, the fur everywhere else, the background and everything else the same.

spark_open.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile standing on a plain light background. Its entire body, neck, head and limbs are covered in dense, shaggy brown fur that is lighter tan around the muzzle, cheeks and chest and darker brown on the lower legs. The head is broad and bear-like with a blunt snout, dark nostrils, small dark eyes and a closed mouth, bearing two horns on the face. The dorsal surface from just behind the neck to the rump is covered by a large, glossy, dark brown domed shell with fine longitudinal ridges and a segmented border, giving the appearance of a beetle's hardened wing covers fused to a furry mammalian body. The animal stands on four thick columnar legs ending in clawed paws, with a very small furry tail barely visible at the rear beneath the shell.

parts.looks_like: broad, bear-like head covered in shaggy brown fur with lighter tan fur on the muzzle and around the mouth, a large dark nose with two nostrils at the tip of the snout, small dark eyes on the sides of the face, and a closed mouth with a slightly visible lower lip
parts.where: at the anterior end of the body on a thick furry neck, facing to the right

parts.looks_like: two dark gray to black, smooth, pointed, keratinous horns; a large long horn that curves upward and slightly backward arising from the tip of the snout just above the nostrils, and a much smaller short conical horn centered on the forehead between the eyes
parts.where: on the face, one on the nose tip and one on the mid-forehead

parts.looks_like: two small, rounded, furry ears covered in dense brown fur with slightly darker edges, upright and cupped
parts.where: on the top of the head, one on each side, behind the forehead

parts.looks_like: four thick, columnar, heavily furred legs with long shaggy brown fur that is darker on the lower portions, two forelimbs under the chest and two hindlimbs under the rear, supporting the body
parts.where: under the body, extending vertically from the torso to the ground

parts.looks_like: four broad paws with visible long, curved, light-colored claws protruding from the fur at the toe tips, the soles in contact with the ground
parts.where: at the distal ends of each leg

parts.looks_like: a very small, short, furry tuft of brown fur
parts.where: at the posterior end of the body at the rump, partially tucked beneath the rear edge of the shell on the left side of the image

parts.looks_like: a large, hard, glossy, dark brown domed shell with a smooth anterior section covering the shoulders and a larger posterior section with fine parallel longitudinal striations and faint cracks, divided by a transverse suture, with a slightly raised rim
parts.where: covering the entire dorsal surface from just behind the neck to the rump, sitting on top of the fur

parts.looks_like: a row of small, rectangular, dark brown marginal plates forming a segmented border with visible sutures between them, and larger plate divisions on the shell surface
parts.where: along the lower perimeter edge of the shell encircling it, and as sutures dividing the shell into anterior and posterior sections

parts.looks_like: natural pelage shading with no spots or stripes; medium brown on the back and sides, lighter tan-beige on the muzzle, cheeks and chest, and darker chocolate brown to near-black on the lower legs and paws

meta_spark.description: A large four-legged mammal standing in right profile with thick shaggy brown fur. It has a broad bear-like head with small rounded ears, dark eyes and a bear-like muzzle, but bearing a long curved dark horn on the nose and a tiny second horn between the eyes. The entire back from behind the head to the rump is covered by a large glossy dark brown domed shell in two sections with fine longitudinal grooves on the rear section and a rim of small rectangular plates along the lower edge. The legs are thick and furry ending in broad clawed paws, and a small furry tail protrudes at the rear beneath the shell.
